dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「と、言うわけで――今日の授業はお〜しまい。
　週番さんは号令」
dialogues.en:
"That's all for today. Can the person on the rota direct the
class to leave."
dialogues.text:
"That's all for today. Can the person on the rota direct the
class to leave."

dialogues.jp: ぱん、とさくらが手を鳴らす。
dialogues.en: Sakura claps her hands.
dialogues.text: Sakura claps her hands.

dialogues.jp:
今日１日が丸ごと夢なんじゃないかと思ってい
たが、どうやら現実らしい。
dialogues.en:
I thought everything that's happening here was a dream, but
I guess it is real.
dialogues.text:
I thought everything that's happening here was a dream, but
I guess it is real.

dialogues.jp: 「……長かった」
dialogues.en: "It was a long day."
dialogues.text: "It was a long day."

dialogues.jp: 授業中も昼休みも、ずっとこの時を待っていた。
dialogues.en:
I was waiting for this moment all through classes and lunch
recess.
dialogues.text:
I was waiting for this moment all through classes and lunch
recess.

dialogues.jp:
今日はさくらの担当の授業はなく、人前で接触
なんてしようとも思わなかったし、昼休みも職
員室にいられては手がでない。
dialogues.en:
I didn't have Sakura's class today. Of course, I didn't want
to talk with her in public and go inside the faculty room
during the lunch recess.
dialogues.text:
I didn't have Sakura's class today. Of course, I didn't want
to talk with her in public and go inside the faculty room
during the lunch recess.

dialogues.jp:
やつの首根っこを押さえて、頭を握り締めなが
ら奥歯ガタガタ言わせる時がついに来たのだ。
dialogues.en:
This is the time I should grab her neck and squeeze her
head, making her scared.
dialogues.text:
This is the time I should grab her neck and squeeze her
head, making her scared.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あの、芳乃……先生、まだ週番をどうするか
　決めていませんけど」
dialogues.en:
"Excuse me, Yoshino... sensei. We don't know who's on the
rota."
dialogues.text:
"Excuse me, Yoshino... sensei. We don't know who's on the
rota."

dialogues.jp:
元クラスメートだけあって動揺も大きいだろう
が、ことりはすでに適応している。
dialogues.en:
Kotori seems to be adjusted to the situation, even if she
feels shocked that the teacher is her old classmate.
dialogues.text:
Kotori seems to be adjusted to the situation, even if she
feels shocked that the teacher is her old classmate.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そっか。どうしよっかどうしよっか……
　考え中」
dialogues.en: "Oh, right. What shall I do? Think, think..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, right. What shall I do? Think, think..."

dialogues.jp:
早く終われ〜、早く終われ〜、早く終われ〜
……。
dialogues.en: Finish it, finish, finish now...
dialogues.text: Finish it, finish, finish now...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、出席番号順でいきましょう」
dialogues.en: "Then, let's go in the order of the attendance book."
dialogues.text: "Then, let's go in the order of the attendance book."

dialogues.jp:
早く終われ〜、早く終われ〜、早く終われ〜
……。
dialogues.en: Finish it, finish, finish now...
dialogues.text: Finish it, finish, finish now...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おい朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ。俺の呪いを中断させると恐ろしいこ
　とが起こるぞ？　食事の中に銀紙が入ってる
　とか」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, don't interrupt my chanting, otherwise something's
gonna happen to you like a piece of an aluminum foil in your
food."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, don't interrupt my chanting, otherwise something's
gonna happen to you like a piece of an aluminum foil in your
food."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、出席番号順だとお前が１番だろう？」
dialogues.en:
"You are the first one according to the attendance book,
aren't you?"
dialogues.text:
"You are the first one according to the attendance book,
aren't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あん？」
dialogues.en: "Um?"
dialogues.text: "Um?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はい、じゃあ朝倉お兄ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Okay, can you do that, Asakura-oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Okay, can you do that, Asakura-oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Ahh!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh!"

dialogues.jp: 俺への衝撃とともにクラス中にも波紋が広がる。
dialogues.en: The shockwave goes deep inside me as well as in the class.
dialogues.text: The shockwave goes deep inside me as well as in the class.

dialogues.en: "Hey... Sakura..."
dialogues.text: "Hey... Sakura..."

dialogues.jp: こめかみをおさえて、ギリギリと立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: I stand up, embarrassedly rubbing my temple.
dialogues.text: I stand up, embarrassedly rubbing my temple.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら先生」
dialogues.en: "Sakura-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Sakura-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら」
dialogues.en: "Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら先生」
dialogues.en: "Sakura-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Sakura-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら」
dialogues.en: "Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ……学園では公私混同しちゃダメだよ、
　お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm... You can't mix private and public matters at school,
oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"Hm... You can't mix private and public matters at school,
oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「公私混同してるのはお前だーーーっ！！」
dialogues.en: "You are the one who's doing it!!"
dialogues.text: "You are the one who's doing it!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hmmm!!"
dialogues.text: "Hmmm!!"

dialogues.jp:
近寄ってきたさくらの首をひっつかまえて、
ヘッドロックをかます。
dialogues.en:
I grab her neck when she gets closer to me, and give her a
headlock.
dialogues.text:
I grab her neck when she gets closer to me, and give her a
headlock.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっとコイツと話があるから、全員帰れ
　〜！」
dialogues.en: "I have to talk to her, so everyone can go home now!"
dialogues.text: "I have to talk to her, so everyone can go home now!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「嫌だ嫌だぁ！　夢の講師になって初めてのホー
　ムルームなのに〜！」
dialogues.en:
"No way! This is my first homeroom after finally achieving
my dream of becoming a teacher!"
dialogues.text:
"No way! This is my first homeroom after finally achieving
my dream of becoming a teacher!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「このまま永遠の夢にしてやるわぁ！！」
dialogues.en: "I can make this dream last forever!"
dialogues.text: "I can make this dream last forever!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はい、撤収〜」
dialogues.en: "Okay, now go home!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, now go home!"

dialogues.jp:
気の抜けた声とともに、ため息混じりに座席を
立つ音が教室に響き渡った。
dialogues.en:
The sound of chairs scraping as people get up mixes with
their sighs.
dialogues.text:
The sound of chairs scraping as people get up mixes with
their sighs.

dialogues.jp: 「ふふふふっふ……」
dialogues.en: "Huhuhhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huhuhhh..."

dialogues.jp:
重たい鉄の扉が、背中越しに強い風に吹かれて
閉じる。
dialogues.en: A heavy metal door behind me was closed by a strong wind.
dialogues.text: A heavy metal door behind me was closed by a strong wind.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ……うにゃ……」
dialogues.en: "Hm... Woww..."
dialogues.text: "Hm... Woww..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「さぁ、どこにも逃げ場はないぞ。さらに泣い
　ても叫んでも助けはこないっぽい」
dialogues.en:
"Now you can't go anywhere. Whether you cry or scream,
nobody will hear you."
dialogues.text:
"Now you can't go anywhere. Whether you cry or scream,
nobody will hear you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あにょー……そういう台詞はムードのある場
　所で聞きたかったかなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Umm... I wish I could hear that line when I'm in bed."
dialogues.text: "Umm... I wish I could hear that line when I'm in bed."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「棺桶の中で聞かせてやろうか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to hear it in your coffin?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to hear it in your coffin?"

dialogues.jp: 拳を握り締めて目を細める。
dialogues.en: I narrow my eyes and make a fist.
dialogues.text: I narrow my eyes and make a fist.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ただ今、この場でお話させていただきます
　……ぜひ」
dialogues.en: "Please, let me explain it to you."
dialogues.text: "Please, let me explain it to you."

dialogues.jp: しゅん、とさくらが肩を落とす。
dialogues.en: Sakura drops her shoulders.
dialogues.text: Sakura drops her shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えと、ボク、先生になるのが夢だったんだ
　……昔から」
dialogues.en: "Well, I've wanted to be a teacher since I was a kid."
dialogues.text: "Well, I've wanted to be a teacher since I was a kid."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふふっふ……」
dialogues.en: "Huhhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huhhh..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そ、それで、地元の風見学園から声がかかっ
　て、とりあえず付属に通わせて講師の適正を
　見ようと……」
dialogues.en:
"Then, Kazami Academy called me to ask if I wanted to try as
a student at first, and move up to the position of a teacher
if I pass the test."
dialogues.text:
"Then, Kazami Academy called me to ask if I wanted to try as
a student at first, and move up to the position of a teacher
if I pass the test."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えと、まぁ、で、お兄ちゃんや音夢ちゃんに
　言わなかったのは、全面的にびっくり爆発さ
　せようと思って黙ってたんだけど……」
dialogues.en:
"So... The reason I didn't tell you and Nemu-chan was
because I wanted to surprise you."
dialogues.text:
"So... The reason I didn't tell you and Nemu-chan was
because I wanted to surprise you."

dialogues.jp: こっくり、とさくらが首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Sakura tilts her head.
dialogues.text: Sakura tilts her head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「びっくりした？」
dialogues.en: "Were you surprised?"
dialogues.text: "Were you surprised?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「爆発したわ！」
dialogues.en: "Of course I was!"
dialogues.text: "Of course I was!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Aahhh..."
dialogues.text: "Aahhh..."

dialogues.jp:
薄っぺらい上履きで、分厚いアスファルトを削
り取るような勢いで踏みしめる。
dialogues.en:
I try to get a grip, with my feet in the thin slippers on
the thick asphalt floor.
dialogues.text:
I try to get a grip, with my feet in the thin slippers on
the thick asphalt floor.

dialogues.jp: 全然わからない……。
dialogues.en: I don't understand at all.
dialogues.text: I don't understand at all.

dialogues.jp: なんで、こんなに腹が立っているんだ俺は？
dialogues.en: Why am I so angry?
dialogues.text: Why am I so angry?

dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、じゃあ、最近家にいなかったり、
　連絡つかなかったのはそのせいか？」
dialogues.en:
"That's why you've not been at home and I haven't been able
to get hold of you lately."
dialogues.text:
"That's why you've not been at home and I haven't been able
to get hold of you lately."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ＹＥＳ。講義とか事務の講習を受けててさ
　……あの、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I was taking lectures and training programs for office
duties. Sorry..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I was taking lectures and training programs for office
duties. Sorry..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」
どっ、と疲れて地面にしゃがみこむ。
dialogues.en: I squat down on the ground, losing strength.
dialogues.text: I squat down on the ground, losing strength.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、どうしたのお兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Hm, what's wrong, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, what's wrong, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、なに……そっか……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I see..."
dialogues.text: "Well, I see..."

dialogues.jp: へへへ、と笑みがこぼれる。
dialogues.en: I suddenly smile.
dialogues.text: I suddenly smile.

dialogues.jp:
そうだな。みんながみんな、俺の前から消えて
いくわけじゃないんだ。
dialogues.en: Now I know I didn't lose everybody.
dialogues.text: Now I know I didn't lose everybody.

dialogues.jp:
「｛うち／風見｝もバカだとは思っていたが、お前なんか
　を講師にするほどバカだったか」
dialogues.en:
"I know the people at Kazami Academy are idiots, but now I
realize they are the true idiots to give you a position as a
teacher."
dialogues.text:
"I know the people at Kazami Academy are idiots, but now I
realize they are the true idiots to give you a position as a
teacher."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃ！　ひどいなぁ。これでも短期間にあら
　かたのことを覚えられたんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm! You're so mean. I've learned most of the things I need
for teaching in such a short time."
dialogues.text:
"Hm! You're so mean. I've learned most of the things I need
for teaching in such a short time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ……」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: そこで言葉を切って空を見上げた。
dialogues.en: I stop and look up at the sky.
dialogues.text: I stop and look up at the sky.

dialogues.jp:
まったくもって、４月の空はバカみたいに青い。
今日は４月１日ではないのだ。
dialogues.en:
The sky in April is tremendously blue. Today isn't an April
Fool's Day,though.
dialogues.text:
The sky in April is tremendously blue. Today isn't an April
Fool's Day,though.

dialogues.jp: 「……面倒なこった」
dialogues.en: "It's a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "It's a pain in the neck."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ〜……なんか今日のお兄ちゃん変だ
　よ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... You seem different today, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... You seem different today, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp:
座り込みながら、意外に近くにあるさくらの顔
を見上げた。
dialogues.en: I look up at Sakura as I sit on the ground.
dialogues.text: I look up at Sakura as I sit on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……なんで先生になんてなろうと思った？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you want to be a teacher?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you want to be a teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それが夢だから」
dialogues.en: "Because it was my dream."
dialogues.text: "Because it was my dream."

dialogues.jp: 間髪いれず答えが返ってくる。
dialogues.en: She responded as quick as a flash.
dialogues.text: She responded as quick as a flash.

dialogues.en: "Dream?"
dialogues.text: "Dream?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そう、夢」
dialogues.en: "Yes, a dream."
dialogues.text: "Yes, a dream."

dialogues.jp:
夢は現実ではなく、未来か、眠っているときに
見るものだ。
dialogues.en:
A dream is not for the present but for the future or when
you're sleeping.
dialogues.text:
A dream is not for the present but for the future or when
you're sleeping.

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossoms that never die.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossoms that never die.

dialogues.jp: 和菓子を生み出す力。
dialogues.en: The magic power to create Japanese snacks.
dialogues.text: The magic power to create Japanese snacks.

dialogues.jp: 同世代の講師。
dialogues.en: A teacher of my age.
dialogues.text: A teacher of my age.

dialogues.jp:
それならば、この世界そのものが、｛うたかた／泡沫｝の夢の
ように思えてくる。
dialogues.en:
The world I'm in could be a dream that could vanish like
smoke.
dialogues.text:
The world I'm in could be a dream that could vanish like
smoke.

dialogues.jp: 「まいったな……」
dialogues.en: "I'm fed up..."
dialogues.text: "I'm fed up..."

dialogues.jp: 我ながら頭の痛い考えに顔をしかめる。
dialogues.en: I uncross my brows to try to avoid a headache.
dialogues.text: I uncross my brows to try to avoid a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボク、先生っぽいことしていい？」
dialogues.en: "Can I say something as a teacher?"
dialogues.text: "Can I say something as a teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「夢は、希望とか将来を語るものではないんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en: "A dream won't decide your hope or your future."
dialogues.text: "A dream won't decide your hope or your future."

dialogues.jp:
屋上で自身満々に胸を張って、さくらがピンと
指を立てる。
dialogues.en: Standing on the rooftop, she raises her fingers up proudly.
dialogues.text: Standing on the rooftop, she raises her fingers up proudly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「夢とは、戦って歯をくいしばって叶えつづけ
　るものなんだ♪」
dialogues.en: "A dream is what you make it happen by fighting for it."
dialogues.text: "A dream is what you make it happen by fighting for it."

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらの夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura's dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura's dream◆

dialogues.jp:
ＨＲの後、さくらをつかまえて屋上で講師になっ
たいきさつを詰問する。
dialogues.en:
After the homeroom was done, I asked Sakura why she wanted
to be a teacher on the rooftop.
dialogues.text:
After the homeroom was done, I asked Sakura why she wanted
to be a teacher on the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
それが夢で、音夢と俺を驚かせたかったと語る
さくらに怒ろうとしたのだが、なぜか再会でき
たことに安心してしまった。
dialogues.en:
When she said it was her dream and wanted to surprise Nemu
and me, I was so mad, but I felt more relieved that I could
see her again.
dialogues.text:
When she said it was her dream and wanted to surprise Nemu
and me, I was so mad, but I felt more relieved that I could
see her again.
